item.title: NOTICE OF RATIFICATION OF A MINOR RULES VIOLATION
item.description:
Citywide Administrative Services | Special Materials | Notice In plain English (machine-written): On Oct. 14, 2026, the city's chief procurement officer approved a request from the Department of Citywide Administrative Services that acknowledged the agency missed a two-day deadline to notify two low bidders that their bids were non-responsive for a contract to buy asphalt rollers, and the award went ahead to the next qualified bidder.

On October 14, 2026, pursuant to Section 1-02(h)(1)(ii) of the New York City Procurement Policy Board Rules (PPB Rules), the City Chief Procurement Officer (CCPO) ratified a Minor Rules Violation request submitted by the New York City Department of Citywide Administrative in connection with a Competitive Sealed Bid solicitation for Rollers, Asphalt DOT, EPIN 85726B0029002.

The minor rules violation occurred when the Agency failed to notify the two lowest bidders of its determination that their bids were non-responsive within the two-day period required under Section 2-07 of the PPB Rules. This oversight did not affect the evaluation of bids, compromise the integrity of the procurement process, or alter the determination to award the contract to the next lowest responsive and responsible bidder. Upon identifying the violation, the Agency notified the affected bidders and proceeded with the award in accordance with the PPB Rules.

item.title: 85625P0004-RFP Appraisal of Real Estate
item.description:
Citywide Administrative Services | Procurement | Solicitation | Due: 2026-10-22 In plain English (machine-written): The Department of Citywide Administrative Services is seeking up to five vendors to provide real estate appraisal reports in New York City through work orders, chosen from competing proposals due Oct. 22, 2026.

The City of New York Department of Citywide Administrative Services (DCAS) is seeking up to five (5) qualified vendors (hereafter, the Vendor(s) and Contractor(s)) to perform appraisal reports of real estate in New York City, through the issuance of Work Orders. Appraiser may occasionally be required to perform appraisals outside of New York City as needed by DCAS. This solicitation is being made pursuant to the Competitive Sealed Proposal Method, Section 3-03 of the New York City Procurement Policy Board (PPB) Rules. DCAS Office of Citywide Procurement, Agency 856 will hold a virtual Pre-Proposal Conference. Please see the Address Location box in PASSPort for the link. If you are experiencing any difficulties responding to this RFx, please reach out to MOCS service desk at the following link: http://nyc.gov/mocshelp
